c74object.name: evi_4wave
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. Anti-aliased Saw, Rect, Tri and Sine simultaneous oscillators
c74object.description:
evi_4wave is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
evi_4wave.gendsp requires the GenExpr file(s):
evi_polyblep_four.genexpr, evi_polyblep_utility.genexpr
evi_4wave is also available in MSP as: evi.4wave~.
Phase synchronous shared frequency oscillators with simultaneous Saw, Rect, Tri and Sine outputs. Anti-aliasing method is 4-point polyblep.

geninlet.name: frequency
geninlet.digest: in Hz. Frequency of all 4 oscillators.

geninlet.name: reset
geninlet.digest: Naive. Reset is naive and not anti-aliased.

attribute.name: zerosync
attribute.description: If on, tri phase is aligned at zero crossings with the other three oscillators. If off (slightly cheaper) tri phase is at the peak of the tri shape.
